subject.title: fix(qa): simplify smoke lanes and isolate fanout

question: Should automatic QA Smoke prioritize the final 12-scenario taxonomy-representative set instead of executing every eligible smoke scenario?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but regression-detection breadth versus runner registrations and runtime is an intentional CI policy choice that tests cannot resolve.

options.title: Adopt representative smoke
options.body: Accept the proven two-profile curated set, retain exhaustive execution through explicit QA profiles, correct the PR description, and refresh exact-merge checks.

options.title: Retain broad automatic smoke
options.body: Keep every eligible scenario in routine CI while preserving the packaged-runtime reuse, focused Playwright, and isolation improvements.

options.title: Keep automatic smoke disabled
options.body: Pause re-enablement if maintainers do not accept either the narrower coverage or the runtime and runner cost of broad execution.

recommendation.title: Adopt representative smoke
recommendation.body: Accept the proven two-profile curated set, retain exhaustive execution through explicit QA profiles, correct the PR description, and refresh exact-merge checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They implemented and measured the final coverage and fanout design and have the strongest recent operational context.
